rule_summary_es: Contrato conceptual para identificar inasistencia escolar en poblacion aplicable sin codificar reglas operativas
main_risks: Applicable ages and school-cycle equivalence must be confirmed. Non-applicable children must not be treated as deprived

rule_summary_es: Contrato conceptual para identificar no acceso a educacion superior por razones economicas sin codificar reglas operativas
main_risks: Reason-for-nonattendance variable and higher-education universe must be confirmed

rule_summary_es: Contrato conceptual para identificar logro educativo incompleto sin codificar umbrales ni equivalencias
main_risks: Schooling equivalence, attendance status, and age threshold must be audited against official methodology

rule_summary_es: Contrato conceptual para identificar empleo infantil y adolescente sin reconstruir condact desde preguntas crudas
main_risks: Child labor definition must be reviewed. Existing labor flags may not cover all IPM age and activity rules

rule_summary_es: Contrato conceptual para identificar desempleo o empleo inadecuado usando clasificacion laboral consolidada pendiente de mapeo IPM
main_risks: Must respect consolidated condact and validated labor flags. Do not reconstruct labor status from raw questionnaire items

rule_summary_es: Contrato conceptual para identificar no contribucion al sistema de pensiones sin codificar elegibilidad ni excepciones
main_risks: Contribution variable and eligible population must be confirmed before implementation

rule_summary_es: Contrato conceptual para usar pobreza extrema por ingresos como privacion IPM despues de resolver lineas auditables
main_risks: Must not compute income poverty without explicit auditable poverty lines. Non-positive income policy must remain explicit

rule_summary_es: Contrato conceptual para identificar hogares sin servicio de agua por red publica sin fijar codigos operativos
main_risks: IPM water rule may differ from NBI basic-services rule. Public-network definition must be verified

rule_summary_es: Contrato conceptual para identificar hacinamiento sin confirmar umbral operativo IPM
main_risks: Household-size and bedroom definitions must be verified for IPM. Household repetition must preserve person-level analysis

rule_summary_es: Contrato conceptual para identificar deficit habitacional sin codificar materiales ni deficit cualitativo o cuantitativo
main_risks: Housing deficit may require variables beyond NBI housing quality. Official coding review is required

rule_summary_es: Contrato conceptual para identificar hogares sin saneamiento de excretas sin fijar codigos operativos
main_risks: IPM sanitation rule is area-specific. Urban and rural excreta-disposal thresholds must be verified separately

rule_summary_es: Contrato conceptual para identificar hogares sin servicio de recoleccion de basura sin fijar variable operativa
main_risks: Garbage collection source variable and service categories must be confirmed in official dictionaries
